title: Hull Breach Knock
description: A single low designed percussion hit built from a short-decay square voice and a snapping lowpass envelope, gated into broken euclidean stutters by ply and a glitching mask. Over 24 cycles the filter env opens, the pitch envelope deepens, and the stutter rate mutates so the hit drifts from a dry knock to a malfunctioning metallic clatter.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<g1 g1 [g1 ~] eb1>(<3 5 3 7>,8)").s("square")
    .ply("<1 1 2 <1 3>>/4")
    .penv(sine.slow(24).range(-8, -22)).pattack(0.001).pdecay("<0.04 0.06 0.03>/8")
    .lpf(sine.slow(19).range(180, 1600)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(8, 18)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(24).range(2, 7)).lpattack(0.002).lpdecay("<0.05 0.09 0.04>/4")
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.12).sustain(0).release(0.02)
    .shape(sine.slow(17).range(0.2, 0.55)).crush("<16 8 6 10>/8")
    .mask("<1 1 1 [1 0 1 1]>/2")
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1).coarse(4))
    .off(0.02, x => x.add(note(0.15)).gain(0.3).pan(0.7).hpf(400))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .room(0.22).delay("0.3:0.1875:0.5").orbit(2)
    .gain(0.95)
)
